items.title: AI/R Compass UOL Wins 2026 Oracle Partner Award for Latin America

items.title: Bluehost Brings AI to Life for Small Businesses Worldwide

items.title: CDK Global Appoints Tim Karaca as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: AUSTIN, Texas, November 05, 2026--CDK, the leading automotive retail software provider, today announced the appointment of Tim Karaca as executive vice president and chief financial officer. He succeeds Steve Lifshatz, who will remain with CDK through the end of 2026 to support a seamless transition.
